answer: The mechanism I trust most: on-ledger slashing of verifiers who countersign invalid transactions. Each verifier stakes collateral, and a signature proven invalid burns it, priced above many epochs of rewards. Sybil attacks become hollow because extra identities multiply capital at risk without multiplying honest yield. Like a trellis holding vines, the stake lattice supports the economy; like a river, value flows only through channels guarded by skin in the game. Forging costs more than any reward pays, so fake identities are unprofitable.
